baseline.tests: Archived checkout plus first regression test file, before any migration fix
baseline.result: 9 failing subtests. Missing and invalid choices and simulated zero free space all allowed startup. Discard copied 100 rows.

candidate.installer_source_regression_result: 14 tests passed in 0.870s. The original writable snapshot reader changed the main database and removed an 8 MiB crash-left WAL after free-space refusal. The read-only source preserved both durable file hashes on refusal and successful backup. The snapshot included committed WAL payload, passed integrity_check and had zero foreign key violations.
candidate.space_fixture: Unnumbered baseline with named_admins removed. 100 distinct 2 MiB stored payloads plus 200 UTF-8 header bytes. Half the historical request IDs are blank. SQLite page size 4096.
candidate.measurement: Poll regular-file lengths, allocated blocks, combined WAL and rollback journals in a dedicated data directory at 1 ms intervals during actual EventService startup. Lengths and allocated blocks include both databases, WALs, shared-memory files and other private fixture files. Peaks are sampled lower bounds; allocated-block peaks depend on filesystem allocation.
candidate.baseline_and_candidate_gate: Migrate <= 220 MiB plus 24 MiB journal allowance. Discard <= 24 MiB. Candidate tests assert the limit on both logical and allocated growth when filesystem block counts are available.
